text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Doctors unable to avoid the panic caused by an outbreak of meningitis. In the last few days the number of people who took their children to the paediatrics department of Lisbon and Oporto's hospitals doubled.
- The European Commission has set up a team of 180 specialists to defend the euro.
- Domestic banks set up special accounts for depositors who plan to invest in the partial privatisation of utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal later this year.
- The government wants to privatise state airline TAP-Air Portugal in 1998 with the sell-off of a 49 percent stake, Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira dos Santos told the paper.
- Conditions are not right for the privatisation of mining company EDM-Empresa de Desenvolvimento Mineiro, Under-Secretary for Industry and Energy Jose Penedos told the paper.
